name: The thirsty man
short: Give him a drink within 24 real-world hours, or he leaves for good.
desc: A man on Route 412 is desperate for a drink. Give him a Fresh Water, Soda Pop, Lemonade or any other drink from a vending machine. You have 24 real-world hours: if you don't help him in time, he disappears and the quest is gone.
reward: Jaw Fossil or Sail Fossil, at random

name: Pikachu fan
short: Talk to the girl with a Pikachu while yours follows you.
desc: In the Pokémon Center in Inhore City, talk to the girl with the Pikachu while a Pikachu of your own is following you.

name: A Pokémon that looks like a Poké Ball
short: Walk with a Voltorb or a Foongus.
desc: A student is writing up class notes and wants to see a Pokémon that looks like a Poké Ball. Walk in with a Voltorb or a Foongus following you.

name: Shiny hunt
short: Have a shiny Pokémon in your party and a free slot.
desc: A long-serving Trainer has never seen a Pokémon with unusual colouring. Come back with a shiny Pokémon in your party and a free party slot.

name: Battle Club
short: Beat each of the six club Trainers once.
desc: Downstairs at Inhore University. You need a Gym Badge to get in. Beat each of the six club Trainers once.

name: Fossil revival
short: Hand over a fossil to have it revived.
desc: Hand a fossil to the Archaeology Department. They send it to a laboratory on Cinnabar Island and call you back once the Pokémon is ready. Every fossil up to Gen 6 can be revived; you can dig them up in Groment Mines.
reward: The revived Pokémon, from any of these fossils

name: The Moon Stone guide
desc: Dardusk is permanently dark, so residents tell day from night by the Moon Stones, which glow only at night. A townsperson gives you one to use as a guide.
short: A townsperson gives you a Moon Stone to tell day from night.

name: Shaymin and the Gracidea
short: Walk with Shaymin.
desc: Walk into the Botanic Garden with Shaymin following you. It only works if you don't already carry a Gracidea.

name: The cook's berries
short: Bring three of the berry she asks for.
desc: The cook asks for three of one berry, picked at random each time. Bring her three of it.

name: The Lustroustone
short: Find a Lustroustone in the Mines and show the Director.
desc: Find a Lustroustone in Groment Mines and show it to the Museum Director. (The stone disk you're handed during the robbery is a different stone, the Adamanstone.)

name: The stolen stone
short: Pay the thief $5000.
desc: Pay the thief $5000 to get the stone back.

name: Catch ’Em All
short: Have 50 or more species caught.
desc: Prof. Oak's aide in the gate building by the National Park checks your Pokédex. Have 50 or more species caught. With the medal on (1 medal energy), wild Pokémon are randomly easier to catch, depending on how many species you have registered.

name: Route 411 habitat list
short: Complete Route 411's habitat list with the Dex Radar.
desc: A researcher on Route 409 asks you to complete Route 411's habitat list with the Dex Radar.

name: The cactus Pokémon
short: Walk with a Maractus.
desc: Walk with a Maractus.

name: A Fairy for the forest
short: Walk with a Fairy-type.
desc: A traveller unnerved by the forest wishes she had a Fairy-type. Walk past her with one following you.

name: Bramboach's plane
short: Say yes, you'd be proud of the town's little plane.
desc: Say yes, you'd be proud of the town's little plane.

name: A valuable Egg
short: Accept the Egg, with a free party slot.
desc: Accept the Egg, with a free party slot.

name: TV documentary
short: Bring the Pokémon the writer asks for. New request every day.
desc: The writer at the TV station wants a different Pokémon every day. Bring the one asked for before the date changes.
reward: Heart Scale plus a random piece of Villa furniture

name: Complete the Pokédex
short: Complete the Pokédex and show Prof. Oak.
desc: Fill the Pokédex, then talk to Prof. Oak at the TV station in Central City. With the medal on (6 medal energy), wild Pokémon appear wandering in tall grass.

name: The Villa
desc: An owner moving to Kanto hands over his Villa, furniture and all.

name: The lake trio
desc: Once you reach the end of this version, go back to Pantem Town: Cynthia is inside the house that used to be locked. Talking to her opens Pantem Cave, where a disk puzzle waits. Solve it to release Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf. Like the legendary dogs in HeartGold, they then roam, turning up at random on different routes; the PDA shows where each one is.
short: Free Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf from Pantem Cave once this version is done.
steps: Reach the end of this version.
Go back to Pantem Town. Cynthia is inside the house that used to be locked.
Talk to her. She grants you entry to Pantem Cave.
Solve the disk puzzle inside the cave.
Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf are released and roam, like the legendary dogs in HeartGold: each turns up at random on a different route.
Check the PDA to see where each one is.

name: Coin Case
short: A Game Corner player also hands over some winnings.
desc: A vendor's house in Central City. A lucky player at the Game Corner also hands over some of his winnings.

name: Silph PDA background
desc: At the Poké Ball Corp. in Central City.

name: Experienced medal and HM06 Rock Smash
short: From Prof. Jasmine.
desc: Prof. Jasmine at Inhore University.

name: Max Repel
short: From a mountaineer.
desc: A mountaineer in Inhore City.

name: Mining Kit
short: After the robbery. Sell Mines treasures to the Museum.
desc: Groment Museum, after the robbery. It lets you sell treasures from the Mines to the Museum.

name: Rockbreaker Feet medal
short: From a miner.
desc: A miner in Groment Mines.

name: Imprisonment medal
short: Map data says Route 405; the guide says 406–407.
desc: A house at a rest area. The map data says Route 405; the guide says Route 406–407.

name: Magikarp PDA background
short: From a fisherman.
desc: A fisherman on Route 408.

name: Daily random item
short: A girl gives you a random item every day.
desc: A girl on Route 407 hands you a random item once a day. Each has a 10% chance: Leftovers, Poké Doll, TwistedSpoon, Poké Ball, BlackGlasses, Repel, Rare Candy, Ether, Silk Scarf, Wide Lens.

name: TM05 Roar
short: From an Ace Trainer.
desc: An Ace Trainer (F) on Route 412.

name: Toxic Orb
desc: Dardusk Woods.

name: Larvesta Egg
short: On an altar. Needs a free party slot.
desc: On an altar in the Sun Palace. Needs a free party slot.

name: Old Rod
short: In a fisherman's house.
desc: A fisherman's house in the Panotem Islands.

name: Good Rod
desc: The Fishing Guru's house on Route 408 (needs Surf).

name: SilverPowder
short: From a Bug Catcher.
desc: A Bug Catcher on Route 402.

name: Dungeon Key
short: Reach into the urn.
desc: Reach into the urn in Shadow Tower.

name: Mt. Origin expedition
desc: She is organising the expedition to Mt. Origin and wants you along once it is ready.

name: The search for the Plates
desc: Agreed in Dardusk City. The map found in Central City may hold the locations of many of the Plates.

name: Find Team Steam's base
desc: He has not forgotten the mission the two of you discussed: hit Team Steam where it hurts by finding their base.
